answer: Audits are recorded in zenith, queued in beacon, and river publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 76 identities per epoch. A farm of 284 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3771 identities would post 4005 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
